definitions.explanation: A political entity with sovereignty over a territory and its people.

examples.japanese: {国家|こっか}の{安全|あんぜん}を{守|まも}る。
{国家|こっか}{予算|よさん}が{承認|しょうにん}された。
{国家|こっか}{資格|しかく}を{取|と}りたい。
examples.english: I want to obtain a national qualification.

examples.japanese: {国家|こっか}と{個人|こじん}の{関係|かんけい}は、{時代|じだい}とともに{変化|へんか}してきた。{近代|きんだい}{国家|こっか}では{市民|しみん}の{権利|けんり}が{重視|じゅうし}される。
examples.english: The relationship between the state and individuals has changed over time. In modern nations, citizens' rights are emphasized.

notes:
{国家|こっか} is a formal term for state or nation.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {国家|こっか}として (as a nation)
- {国家|こっか}{的|てき} (national, state-level)

COMPOUND WORDS:
- {国家|こっか}{安全|あんぜん}{保障|ほしょう} (national security)
- {国家|こっか}{予算|よさん} (national budget)
- {国家|こっか}{資格|しかく} (national qualification/license)
- {国家|こっか}{機密|きみつ} (state secret)
- {国家|こっか}{権力|けんりょく} (state power)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {国家|こっか}: state, nation (formal, political)
- {国|くに}: country (general, everyday)
- {国民|こくみん}: citizens, people
- {民族|みんぞく}: ethnic group, race
